QuestInfo.name: Tools for the Magic Show
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Bouffon has way with words. It looks like he is going to put up some sort of an magic show. Maybe you should take a look.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Bouffon ruins the magic show with some lame magic. But he says he has something that will surprise everyone. Go get tools to help Mr. Bouffon's magic show.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the tools for the magic show to Mr. Bouffon. But you still don't think that magic show will be very popular.

1.0: Did you get all the tools we need for the magic show?

yes.0: Great, now I should be able to perform my incredible tricks. Come and see!
